market_question: Will Wesley Said be the top goal scorer in the 2025-26 Ligue 1 season?
reasoning: Wesley Said is a backup striker for Lens with a career-best 9 Ligue 1 goals; he scored only 4 in 27 games in 2024‑25 and has never been near the top-scorer race. The chance he suddenly leads the league is astronomically smaller than the 0.1% implied by the market.
evidence_points: Said scored 4 Ligue 1 goals in the 2024‑25 season.
His single‑season Ligue 1 high is 9 goals.
Top scorer typically requires 20‑25+ goals in a 34‑match season.
